entities.summary: Charles Simard-Hudon is a Canadian professional ice hockey left winger for Djurgårdens IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was selected in the fifth round, 122nd overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2012 NHL entry draft. Hudon has also previously played for the Colorado Avalanche.
